name: Archisketch
description:
Archisketch is a web-based interior design platform used by designers, architects, and furniture retailers across Asia. This connector gives Claude read-only access to your Archisketch workspace so you can explore projects, analyze costs, and search product catalogs through natural conversation.

What you can do:

• Browse your projects — personal, shared with you, shared by you, or bookmarked — with thumbnails and metadata.
• Get detailed project summaries including floorplans, room layouts with polygons, placed furniture with positions, and applied finish materials.
• Calculate project costs broken down by room, floorplan, and category (furniture vs. finishes), with net totals.
• Export formal estimate documents as downloadable PDFs.
• Search the public building catalog by apartment or building name and retrieve available floorplans with area information.
• Search the furniture library (enterprise-wide or personal) by keyword, name, tags, or SKU, and see pricing, dimensions, and variants.
• Search the finish material library (tile, wallpaper, paint, flooring) with brand, pricing, and texture previews.
• View images in a rich gallery format — renderings, product photos, and material textures.

This connector is read-only. It cannot create, modify, or delete projects, edit floorplans, or change furniture placement. All data access requires OAuth authentication through your Archisketch account.

Ideal for:
— Designers reviewing project details and costs in conversation
— Sales teams generating estimates and comparing product options
— Managers getting quick summaries across multiple projects

_published_faq.name: How do I add Archisketch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Archisketch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.archisketch.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Archisketch MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Archisketch provides these MCP tools: export-project-estimate, get-bookmarked-projects, get-my-projects, get-project-cost, get-project-summary, get-projects-shared-by-me, get-projects-shared-with-me, get-user-info, search-finishes, search-furniture-library, search-public-floorplans, and show-images.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Archisketch?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Archisketch in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Archisketch requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Archisketch is developed by Archisketch. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
